name: Done-for-you Title II accessibility remediation (documents + caption QA) for public bodies, verifier-checked
justification: 17 local bodies with 2026 spending ($7.5k-$60k); $3-12/page list; CA city managers can buy $10-50k without bids; deadline Apr 26 2027 is 5.5 months away; pipeline measured: ~45% of real pages pass after one automatic fix round, the rest need human work; minor must contract via parent LLC; DOJ may weaken rule.

name: Permit + PTO/interconnection desk for small CA solar/battery/EV-charger installers
justification: Vendor-page prices $130-749/project; small installers decide fast; needs PE-stamp partner, installer portal credentials, error liability; residential solar contracting after 25D ended; SolarAPP+ and offshore drafters compress price; automation untested.

name: Catch-up bookkeeping before tax season
justification: $150-500 per backlog month; seasonal; owners hesitate to give a minor bank access; crowded; weak path to a company.

name: Trucking owner-operator back office (detention recovery, invoicing)
justification: Dispatch 5-10% of gross; detention recovery hard to collect; DockPay and dispatch services exist; trust barrier.

name: Grant writing for small nonprofits
justification: $500-15,000 per proposal; outcome uncertain; commission fees considered unethical; slow award cycles.

name: Credentialing/payer enrollment for small therapy practices
justification: $100-300 per payer; payers take months (slow cash); handles SSNs and provider PII; Headway/Alma/Medallion compete.

name: Verification-only SaaS (round-1 winner)
justification: No one shown to pay for verification separately; red team's most likely cause of death; slower money.

name: ADU plan-check corrections / expediting
justification: $1.5-9k per project but design revisions need licensed designers; one-off buyers.
